findings.reason: Development-only Ant Design CLI glob parsing. The CLI consumes repository-controlled paths; do not run it against untrusted patterns. The advisory names 3.0.4 as fixed, but the npm registry currently publishes only 3.0.3.

The SPA uses v6. Its navigation targets are internal routes; external provider authorization uses explicit links rather than router navigation. The fixed v7 line requires a separately verified router migration. Review every newly introduced navigation target for untrusted backslashes.
The embedded SPA is client rendered. It has no React Router server rendering, hydration error deserialization or user-controlled server hydration payload. Reassess before introducing SSR.
